source_refs.note: 'Everyday Applications of Machine Learning' under topic 6.5, as printed (PDF 81, printed 77).

blocks.text: Machine learning is used in daily life activities. Mobile phones use it for face recognition. Voice assistants understand spoken commands. Social media shows personalized content. Email services filter spam messages. Navigation apps suggest routes. Online platforms recommend videos and music. Smart devices use machine learning and daily tasks become easier and faster.
